children: SMAG now expects 2026 total output of €47M–€52M, down from €55M–€60M, and an adjusted EBIT margin of 8%–10%, down from 19%–21%. Supplier delays pushed project deliveries and acceptances into 2027.
The sharp reduction signals substantially lower expected profitability; delayed projects and higher start-up costs are cited.
The lower forecast reflects supplier-related delays and customer acceptances postponed from Q4 2026.
Order backlog rose 76% to €247M by Oct. 30
The release compares this with €140M at Dec. 31, 2025, supporting management's growth outlook for 2027.
SMAG expects very strong 2027 output growth
Management expects delayed projects to move into 2027, but provides no quantified 2027 forecast.

This is a material downgrade to 2026 guidance, alongside a reported increase in firm-order backlog and management's expectation of stronger 2027 performance. Confirmation of delayed project deliveries and customer acceptances, alongside quantified 2027 guidance, would make the outlook a larger catalyst.
from SMAG Mobile Antenna Masts AG distributed by EQS.
